questions.question: Which Horcrux is locked in Bellatrix Lestrange's vault at Gringotts?
questions.note: Hermione takes Polyjuice to pass as Bellatrix. Anything they touch in the vault multiplies and burns. She later destroys the cup in the Chamber with a basilisk fang.

questions.question: How do Harry, Ron, and Hermione escape Gringotts?
questions.note: The dragon was chained in the lower vaults as a guard. They break its chains and ride it out through the roof.

questions.question: Which ghost tells Harry where Ravenclaw's diadem is hidden?
questions.note: She is Helena Ravenclaw, Rowena's daughter. She stole the diadem and hid it. Voldemort turned it into a Horcrux and left it in the Room of Requirement.

questions.question: In the film, who casts Fiendfyre in the Room of Requirement and dies in it?
questions.note: He cannot control the cursed fire. Harry and Ron pull Draco and Blaise out. In the book, Crabbe casts the fire. Crabbe is not in the last two films.

questions.question: Who kills Nagini?
questions.note: He pulls the Sword of Gryffindor from the Sorting Hat and cuts the snake's head off during the last standoff.

questions.question: Who lies to Voldemort and says that Harry is dead?
questions.note: She kneels over Harry in the forest and asks, quietly, if Draco is alive. He says yes. She wants to get back into the castle and find her son.

questions.question: Who kills Bellatrix Lestrange?
questions.note: Bellatrix goes after Ginny. Molly steps in front of her daughter and ends the duel in the Great Hall.

questions.question: What spell does McGonagall use to bring the castle's statues and suits of armor to life?
questions.note: She casts it after Snape flees the Great Hall. The stone soldiers march out to defend the school.

questions.question: Which Weasley twin is killed in the Battle of Hogwarts?
questions.note: George survives. The film shows the family around Fred's body in the rubble.

questions.question: Who carries Harry's body out of the Forbidden Forest?
questions.note: Voldemort makes the school watch. Harry is not dead. He is waiting for the right moment to move.
